description: SP2/W of the u(q₀) spin-part derivation (#4401): the braid word's closed geodesic on the 4₁ cusp torus (author steering — braid word ↦ geodesic flow, odd/even channels, sinh/cosh alignment). Combining two proved corpus inputs — meridian log-holonomy = ln q₀ (meridian-holonomy-boost) and cusp shape ω = e^{iπ/3} (cusp-shape-bar-parity) — the (m,ℓ) winding geodesic has u = ln q₀·(m+ℓω) and Im 𝔙₄₁ = (√3/16)(ln q₀)²·[(2m+ℓ)²−3ℓ²], the norm form of ℤ[√3] (disc 12), matching the cusp's own √−3. The form never vanishes (√3 irrational): every geodesic is strictly boost- or spin-dominated. The sinh/cosh alignment is exact: G=1 is the Pell equation whose units (2+√3)ⁿ give (x,y)=(cosh nρ, sinh nρ/√3), ρ=arccosh 2, and (barEven,barOdd)=(2x,2√3y) satisfies the PROVED holonomy hyperbola barEven²−barOdd²=4 — the proved boost identity IS the Pell equation of the winding lattice. The longitude (0,1) gives G=−2<0: the spin-dominated regime SP1 called unreachable IS reached (SP1's wall was an artifact of its off-lattice fibre ansatz; the 60° cusp angle gives Im/Re=√3>1 free of q₀). So the sign of Im 𝔙₄₁ is a discrete ARITHMETIC invariant of the winding, not a q₀-hypersensitivity — the first derivable non-smooth candidate for the SP2 crux. HONEST NEGATIVE (scope-(a)): at the derived scale the magnitudes are not reproduced — S_muon/B ≈ 8.2, S_proton/B ≈ −33.5 are not G values and the canonical meridian/longitude pair predicts ratio −1/2 vs observed ≈ −4.08; moreover many G-pairs match that ratio within 1% by chance, so ratio-matching is a fit trap. Sign mechanism only; no (m,ℓ) adopted. No fit, no c_k, no instance.
